annotations.title: Ask Trip-Pups to help with sign-up

description: [Trip-Pups(트립펍스) — 외국인 축제 찾기·신청] Ask the Trip-Pups team (real people) to help the traveler sign up for an event, e.g. when the official page is Korean-only or needs a Korean phone number. This does NOT sign up or book anything by itself: the request is stored, the team is notified, and a team member emails the traveler within 24-48 hours. Returns a reference number for check_application_status. Requires the traveler's agreement to share their name and email. Our 1:1 sign-up help is free. We only use your own name and details. We never complete identity or phone verification for you or with our accounts. Some organizers do not allow anyone else to sign up on your behalf; for those events we only guide you through doing it yourself. Name, email, party size and note are stored for up to 90 days; privacy notice: https://trip-pups-mcp.tree8727.workers.dev/privacy
